article.title: We Need a Third Reconstruction: Bishop William Barber Pushes Democrats to Take Action After Midterms
article.content: With Democrats preparing to take control of both houses of Congress in January, Bishop William Barber of Repairers of the Breach argues the coalition that delivered the Democrats their midterm victories must now hold the incoming Congress accountable and keep organizing from the ground up. He and other faith leaders are calling on members of the incoming Congress to join them outside the U.S. Capitol next month to sign “A Pledge for Moral Defiance” — a commitment to pass legislation that addresses the needs of poor and working people and other vulnerable communities. Barber is pushing for what he describes as a Third Reconstruction: a sweeping moral and political agenda that includes a living wage, universal healthcare, protecting voting rights, affordable housing, environmental justice and comprehensive immigration reform. “This was a vote not for Democrats,” says Barber. “It was a vote to say, 'Will you use policy to answer the pain that we are experiencing in this country at this particular moment?'”
